title: Neutral on the nature of cosmic consciousness

statements.text: Priority cosmopsychism is a blueprint that stays neutral about the nature of cosmic consciousness: pantheists may take it to be God’s, others may take it to be only protophenomenal. It need not take the cosmos to be a subject of experience, and since the cosmos may not be complex enough, it may lack a phenomenal self.

sources.quote: We also remain neutral about the nature of the cosmic consciousness.
priority cosmopsychism does not assume that the cosmos is a subject of experience
there is no such thing as the phenomenal self for the cosmic consciousness
